title: Cases Reported to Adult Protective Service and the Child Protective Service
what_it_is: Cases Reported to Adult Protective Service and the Child Protective Service

sections.label: Enquiries and family violence awareness
sections.summary: APS and Child Protective Service enquiries rose in 2021, with more awareness and reporting channels including the NAVH and FAM@FSC.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: For the year 2020, there were 1,196 enquiries received by APS; and in 2021, it was 1,948.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: For enquiries received by the Child Protective Service, this was 5,223 in 2020; and 6,513 in 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: There is increased awareness on family and domestic violence through our public education campaigns, such as the "Break the Silence" campaign.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: And also, there are more channels of reporting of suspected abuse or neglect, following the launch of the 24-hour National Anti-Violence and Sexual Harassment Helpline (NAVH) in February 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: MSF's Strengthening Families Programme at Family Service Centre, or FAM@FSC for short, supports couples who may face greater challenges in their marriage and families showing early signs of stress.

sections.label: Taskforce on Family Violence recommendations
sections.summary: The Taskforce on Family Violence, set up in February 2020, proposed recommendations the Government accepted in principle in October 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: The multi-stakeholder Taskforce on Family Violence, which I co-chair, was set up in February 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: We had proposed a comprehensive set of recommendations to tackle the various aspects of family violence, from upstream prevention and detection, to various efforts to ensure the protection of survivors, to increasing the accountability, as well as the rehabilitation, of perpetrators.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: The Government has accepted, in principle, all the task force's recommendations in October 2021.
